description: Builds the Model Report plugin's 'Model report' for the open CIVIL NX model — cover, contents, materials, sections (with drawings), supports and springs, load cases, combinations and loads, nodes/elements/groups appendix, cross sections, tendons, CIVIL NX pictures, the QC checks and the data sources read — and returns it as download links: html (default), xlsx, docx and/or pdf, in English, French, German, Greek or Polish. Document details (project, client, job no., revision, author, checker, date …) go on the cover. Pictures are rendered by CIVIL NX (POST /view/CAPTURE, the user's own view is left as it is): by default the isometric model view and every figure saved in the model; choose model views, load views, saved figures and beam diagrams with `images` (model_report_images lists them), and the beam diagrams' legend format (exponential/fixed, decimals) there too. Otherwise reads only (GET, plus POST /post/TABLE for tendon coordinates). Runs as a job.

details.description: Document details printed on the cover (all optional).

beamDiagrams.description: Beam force/moment diagrams; need an analysed model.

loadCase.description: Static case or combination name; for a construction stage, the result part (Summation, Dead Load, Tendon Primary …).

keys.description: Picture keys from model_report_images (e.g. model:plan, loads:Traffic, figure:Deflection).

legend.description: Beam diagram legend format. CIVIL NX offers no legend min/max: the range always spans the result.

values.description: Number format of the beam diagrams' legend (CIVIL NX's own is exponential).

loadViews.description: Applied-load views: static load case names, or "all".

modelViews.description: FE model views; true = all four, false = none.

savedFigures.description: Figures saved in the model (by name), or "all" (default).

images.description: Pictures CIVIL NX renders into the report. "none" for none; otherwise an object (omitted fields keep the defaults: modelViews ["iso"], savedFigures "all").

language.description: Language of the check wording / the report: English, French, German, Greek, Polish.

outlierFactor.description: An element longer or shorter than the median length by this factor is an outlier.

tendonCoordinates.description: Read the computed tendon coordinate table (needs an analysed model) when the report has tendons.

toleranceMm.description: Nodes closer than this (mm, 3D) count as coincident.

name: model_report_export
title: Model report document (HTML, Excel, Word, PDF)
